newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher, trade buying noted.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher, trade buying noted.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures held recent lows and ended firmer in featureless Friday trade, floor sources said.
Trade buying supported the market at Thursday's low of 10.29 in March, and accounted for most of the day's volume, estimated at 9,566 lots.
Market sources said prices are oversold and put resistance around 10.56 in March.
The contract finished 0.06 higher to 10.36, having ranged from 10.38 to 10.29. The back months settled unchanged to 0.02 higher.
